scope: Existing capture-review-execute-resume loop; no product or provider qualification implied.
shared_preconditions: Disposable synthetic database identity verified; never use the real dogfood database.
Actual initial target state and IDs recorded locally; case setup completed before timing.

cases.goal: Capture a loose task and find it after reload.
preconditions: Synthetic capture text is absent from Inbox.
Board and existing cards are recorded before capture.
actions: Use the current Inbox capture flow to submit the supplied synthetic text once.
Reload and locate the saved capture.
expected_observations: The intended capture survives reload with the supplied content.
No proposal approval or board mutation is caused merely by capture.
cases.control: The supported capture-save path is a known-good persistence control; a no-op save would not satisfy it.
cases.reset: Recreate the recorded initial state only in this disposable synthetic instance.

cases.goal: Decline an unwanted prepared proposal without changing board work.
preconditions: One supported, unexecuted proposal with recorded intended operations is available.
Record the proposed target card/column state before the decision.
actions: Inspect the proposed operations through the actual review surface.
Use the existing decline/dismiss action without executing; reload the target board.
expected_observations: The intended decline/dismiss disposition is visible under the current product contract.
The target board/card state is unchanged by the rejected operations; proposal metadata may change.
cases.control: Negative board-mutation control; service failure before review is BLOCKED, not a pass.
cases.reset: Recreate the same unexecuted proposal through a supported path in the disposable instance.

cases.goal: Review and execute one intended single-card change.
preconditions: A supported prepared proposal creates only Draft sample checklist in the recorded Backlog column.
The card is absent; initial target and neighboring card state is recorded.
Provider/preparation mode is recorded; preparation failures are not hidden.
actions: Perform the existing explicit approval and execution flow.
Reload the board and inspect the intended card plus neighboring state.
expected_observations: Before explicit execution, the proposed board change has not occurred.
After successful execution, exactly the intended card exists in the intended column and survives reload.
Neighboring state remains unchanged except for documented effects of the intended operation.
cases.control: Successful permitted-execution control paired with P2; counts alone do not prove correct identity or content.
cases.reset: Recreate equivalent initial state independently per revision without overwriting the baseline or real-use database.

cases.goal: Resume work and explain what remains after an interruption.
preconditions: P1 and P3 completed on this pinned instance, or equivalent supported synthetic state was prepared and recorded.
The interruption interval and starting route are declared.
actions: Leave the task for the declared interval, then reopen the product.
Find the saved capture and intended card; explain their relationship and next action without applying the proposal again.
expected_observations: The same recorded capture/card identities and intended durable state are found.
Merely reopening and navigating causes no duplicate application or new board mutation.
Record actual resumption time, help and the human explanation; do not invent a comprehension score.
cases.control: Read/resume no-mutation control; a short interruption is not evidence of next-day retention.
cases.reset: Retain or recreate the recorded post-P1/P3 synthetic state for the compared revision; do not silently mix run states.
